g0w0_lda/Mg2Si.description: All-electron one-shot G0W0 from the LDA (ecalj), production settings: SCF 8^3, GW k mesh 6^3, room-temperature lattice.
g0w0_lda/Mg2Si.column_note_from_archive_README: Columns: q (three, units of 2 pi / a), band, q index, the eigenvalue of the Hamiltonian that entered the calculation, the quasiparticle energy eQP (Z = 1), eQP without Z, and Z; energies in eV. The one-shot G0W0 values of the paper are eQP; in a QSGW run the file of iteration N holds, in the first energy column, the eigenvalues of the static QSGW Hamiltonian built from the self-energy of iteration N - 1.

prod/qsgw.description: Questaal QSGW of Mg2Si, production basis (LMTO with an empty sphere at the 4b site, no APW), GW k mesh 4^3, final self-energy.

prod/qsgw_ladder.description: As prod/qsgw, with ladder diagrams in the screened interaction W (lmgw --bsw, window of 4 valence and 4 conduction bands), final self-energy.

prod/qsgw_ladder_nc8.description: As prod/qsgw_ladder with 8 conduction bands in the ladder window.

prod/qsgw_ladder_nc12.description: As prod/qsgw_ladder with 12 conduction bands in the ladder window.

prod/lda_only.description: LDA of Mg2Si in the production Questaal basis.

basis2/lda.description: LDA of Mg2Si in a larger Questaal LMTO basis (with the empty sphere).

basis2/qsgw.description: QSGW of Mg2Si in the larger basis, final self-energy.

basis2/qsgw_ladder.description: QSGW with ladder diagrams in W in the larger basis (window 4/4), final self-energy.

Mg2Si/gpp_all_electron_density.description: Pseudopotential G0W0 (BerkeleyGW 4.0) from the PBE (PseudoDojo pseudopotentials, Quantum ESPRESSO), 6^3 k mesh, about 900 bands, dielectric cutoff 30 Ry; plasmon-pole model (Hybertsen-Louie GPP) with the charge density of all electrons. Quasiparticle energies are Eqp1 (linearized Dyson equation) of eqp1.dat.

Mg2Si/gpp_valence_density.description: Pseudopotential G0W0 (BerkeleyGW 4.0) from the PBE (PseudoDojo pseudopotentials, Quantum ESPRESSO), 6^3 k mesh, about 900 bands, dielectric cutoff 30 Ry; GPP with the charge density of the valence bands only. Quasiparticle energies are Eqp1 (linearized Dyson equation) of eqp1.dat.

Mg2Si/full_frequency.description: Pseudopotential G0W0 (BerkeleyGW 4.0) from the PBE (PseudoDojo pseudopotentials, Quantum ESPRESSO), 6^3 k mesh, about 900 bands, dielectric cutoff 30 Ry; full frequency dependence (contour deformation), no plasmon-pole model. Quasiparticle energies are Eqp1 (linearized Dyson equation) of eqp1.dat.

Mg2Ge/gpp_semicore_d_valence_density.description: Pseudopotential G0W0 (BerkeleyGW 4.0) from the PBE (PseudoDojo pseudopotentials, Quantum ESPRESSO), 6^3 k mesh, about 900 bands, dielectric cutoff 30 Ry; GPP with the charge density of the Ge 3d and valence bands. Mg2Si|AHC|16|0|core.description: Allen-Heine-Cardona renormalization (Quantum ESPRESSO 7.5 ph.x + postahc.x), LDA, norm-conserving pseudopotentials; perturbed potential on a 6^3 grid Fourier-interpolated (with the dipole term) to the stated q grid. Keys eta*: non-adiabatic, broadening eta in eV; eta0.020_adiabatic: adiabatic. States: G15v = valence-band maximum at Gamma; X1, X3 = the two lowest conduction states at X (bands 5 and 6 of the LDA calculation).
